question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'going.'

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this sentence, we can see that the first part of the sentence is having a structure **Verb + ing (travelling, teaching) **to represent activities.
 
• इस वाक्य में, हम देख सकते हैं कि वाक्य के पहले भाग में गतिविधियों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने के लिए Verb + ing (travelling, teaching) की संरचना है।
 
• Hence, the correct answer is 'going.'
 
• *​​*Correct phrase__: **........ **noticed self-sufficient disabled people **going** about their daily business, .......*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Gerunds** are words that are formed with verbs but act as nouns.
 
• **Present participles** do not act as nouns.
 
• Instead, they act as modifiers or complete progressive verbs.
 
• To find gerunds in sentences, just look for a **verb + ing** that is used as a noun.
